description:
DUAL MOTOR POWER: Features a 48V/1000W dual drive motor, delivering a combined power of 2000W for exceptional speed and performance.

HIGH SPEED: Capable of reaching speeds up to 31KM/H, allowing you to navigate snowy terrains swiftly and efficiently.

PREMIUM BRAKING SYSTEM: OYISLRND hydraulic disc brakes and aluminum alloy front fork ensure top-notch control and safety.

ROBUST FRAME: Crafted from durable aluminum alloy, the frame offers lightweight strength and resilience against harsh conditions.

Fat Tire E Bikes: The 26'' *4.0'' fat tire with tread patterns has a wider contact area which enhances flexibility, excellent grip, wear resistance and anti-skid function to let you safer in rainy day ， The adult electric bicycles provide 3 working modes, Pure electric mode, pedal-assist mode, classic bike mode. You can comfortably ride on the beach, mountain, gravel, mud, puddles and other diverse terrain by using this fat tire electric bike.

COMPREHENSIVE DISPLAY: Integrated instrument panel shows mileage, speed, and battery life; also includes turn signals and alarm for added security.

Excellent Performance in 3 Riding Models:Pure electric mode(40-50km battery range); Pure manpower mode; Pedal assist mode(60-90km battery range); Customize your ride performance with 3 riding modes and Shimano 7-speed，you can enjoy cycling in each mode. Support 180kg(396LBS). Suitable height between 165cm (65in) and 195cm (77in). The perfect disc brakes and lighting system fully protect your safety. Better shock absorption effect will bring you the best riding experience.

Smart Digital LCD Display: The Intelligent LCD display keeps track of real-time speed, battery level, pedal assist level and mileage. Mileage 5 Speed LCD display computer makes it better for you to know clearly about the per hour speed and the whole distance you have ridden, and also you can know the battery remaining capacity of your bike. You can have more choice for 5 speed mode than normal. This electric mountain bike also comes with a bright LED headlight, making you visible and safe at night

Easy to Assemble: This e-bike comes 85% pre-assembled. A video guide is available in the product page. Comes with a rear rack and mudguards.

Good Service& Warranty: Our Ebike comes with shelf + fender + lock + pump + controller bag. With a 12 months warranty for battery, charger, motor and controller. 24 hours Quickly Response.

【UPGRADE】：Electric bike upgrades are based on buyers' feedback and experience! We have upgraded the headlights of electric bicycles and upgraded the color screen instruments!
